summary: A relaxing race game with an endless track and minimalist music.
description:
Fluffy Run: Life is a race, but it can also be fluffy!

This game is a minimalist racing game with an endless track through breathtaking environments. Music is the fuel, music is life! Catch the notes to fuel your fluffy car. 

FLUFFY TRIP
Fluffy Racing is a game where the player's goal is to drive a fluffy car through an endless beautiful arts track.

The car must keep collecting notes to continue the race. If it runs out of fuel, the music stops, the world goes dark and you lose. Collect notes throughout the game in order to keep surfing the music.

RELAX AND ENJOY

The car is so cute that you'll love to travel to a minimalist environment and enjoy the song.

Put on your headphones and enjoy. Let the music, the road, and the scenery relax you as you enjoy this anti-stress moment!

FLUFFIEST CAR
Fluffy Fluff Fur Car is the main character. Enjoy driving through this minimal world, where Fluffy is King!

HOW TO BE THE FLUFFIEST
You have to grab the musical notes because they're your fuel and you want to keep listening to the relaxing song. If you crash into obstacles, you'll lose fuel. So be careful with your fluffy fur car!

Try to drive as far as you can and collect as many coins, so that you can achieve a better cuter fluffy furry car.

WHY DO YOU HAVE TO PLAY FLUFFY RUN?
You want to drive the longest distance and beat your previous record. Collect the coins to upgrade your car to be better in the game, and have a cuter car with different colors and combinations.
Relax and enjoy your fluffy run.

Have fun with this new title from Infinity Games, an expert in minimal and relaxing gameplay! We look forward to bringing you more and more features in future updates.

Check us out at: https://infinitygames.io
